name: dedica-middleware-cloudflare-worker
description: Reference Dedica middleware for Cloudflare Workers (protocol v1): policy, agent detection, serving from Dedica with origin fallback.

DEDICA_SITE_ID.description: Your site id: Dedica → onboarding → **Install the Dedica middleware** → **Site id**.

DEDICA_API_URL.description: Dedica's API. Keep `https://api.getdedica.com` unless Dedica tells you otherwise.

DEDICA_MIDDLEWARE_TOKEN.description: Your middleware token (starts with `dm_`): Dedica → onboarding → **Create token**. It is shown once.
